Senses.Explanation: The term names an observable walking circuit or action, with records specifying its timing, direction, companions, and coordination with rest. Literally, to 'go along walking' or 'walk about.' The term is attested and names an observable bodily action. A late biography makes the direction explicit: at night a recluse goes outside the crag to walk about, the visiting master follows, and 'each walks east and west' (隱者出巖外經行，師亦隨之，第東西各步). A Five Lamps address pairs physical condition and action: 'when well, walk about; when tired, rest' (健即經行困即歇). The same collection records Layman Feng Ji walking about the teaching hall with Foyan when a child recites a line, and records another unnamed questioner 'walking under the pines one evening' when he hears a mountain spring (一夕，松下經行，聞巖泉聲). In the collected old cases, Sudhana searches in all four directions for seven days and finds Meghashri 'walking slowly on another peak' (在別峰上徐步經行). Daily timing is also explicit: a biography says an unnamed questioner ate only after serving the assembly, while Bingseng watched him 'walk about after each meal' (每飯罷經行時). The term is frequently coordinated with sitting and lying as one of the body's recorded activities. These places, times, directions, companions, and contrasts support the plain action word.

Senses.Explanation: Huike's fixed reply in the mind-settling case: ‘having sought the mind, I could not find it. Huike says his mind is not at ease; Bodhidharma tells him to bring the mind so it can be set at ease; Huike answers with this phrase; Bodhidharma replies that the mind has now been set at ease. Yuanwu asks why Huike answered only this. Juelang distinguishes Huike’s utterance from later students repeating it. Zhuanyu Guanheng judges the reply as conceptual understanding. Daxiu Zhu redeploys it in a first-person question, and Wanfeng asks how it should be understood. These uses concern one fixed quoted reply.

Occurrences.Kwic: 藏中，實格言也。要知個中一著，止分真偽，從門入者，定非家珍。語其異，即一宗之內有門庭施設之別；語其同，即兩宗之外無師承秘密之殊。即以一宗計之，如臨濟以三聖為正傳，乃三聖絕而興化傳；佛果以大慧為正傳，乃大慧絕而虎丘傳；洞山以曹山為正傳，乃曹山絕而雲居傳。此一宗竝傳，難分旁正也。以兩宗計之，如雪峰九上洞山，三登投子，終嗣德山，是洞而濟也；丹霞親承馬祖印可，終嗣石頭，是濟而洞也。此兩宗互傳，難分賓主也。智過於師，何煩提掇？魔外慴服，何煩鬬爭？善哉！妙喜自贊云：如化鵾鵬，直自化耳，豈有法哉？笑隱亦抗聲於晦機云：千年桃核裏，覓甚舊時仁？此的的威音那畔話，乃一花五葉之真種子也。當此滄桑陵谷虗空消隕之時，有如山翁和上者，以普心、大心、無邊見心，止尋花葉根株，不問葛藤枝節，俾全沒交涉。如訢師此錄者，忽地冷灰豆𪹼，血濺梵天，豈得與逼塞虗空者同日語哉？感而識之，閣筆三歎。順治丙申嘉平月望，國子司業前戊辰二甲進士虞部郎副廷尉曹溪弟子福徵𭬥李道一居士埽菴譚貞默槃談譔No.1367笑隱訢禪師語錄卷之一湖州路烏回禪寺語錄湖州路烏回禪寺語錄門人廷俊等編師於至大四年八月初一日，就杭州路淨慈禪寺書記寮受請入寺。上堂，云：拈華付法，面壁安心，列派分宗，遞相鈍置。拈拄杖畫

Occurrences.Kwic: 一透得，直至不疑之地否？果于三乘十二分教了了分明，如觀掌中菴摩羅果否？果于十二時中把捉得住，應用隨緣，直下不走作否？果于腳根下事說到行到，橫來豎去，不犯絲毫，開眼合眼，盡在這裏否？須具有恁般見地，纔有恁般作略。不是你麤心大膽，強作主宰，逢人打三十棒，筭得佛法的；不是你鼠竊狗偷，弄聰明，鬥智巧，算得佛法的；不是你糢糊影響，書本上看來，一切相似語，算得佛法的。人生好光景不多，轉眼二三十年，便成衰老。道人聚會，共學無為，選佛場開，心空及第。八十公公入場屋，此事不當兒戲，大家相聚喫莖虀，也要知他滋味。」普說。「千年桃核裏，覓甚舊時仁？這一絡索切忌提起，提起嘮嘮叨叨說個不歇，未免播揚家醜。昨日有人從弁山來，得攖寧法姪語錄一卷，絫絫千萬言辯剝到底，祗因他數十年前三峰藏禪師曾將我洞宗家裏事請益雲門先師翁并博山和尚，當時兩個老漢直直截截一總荅他去了，只是不曾下得一個註腳，煩他三峰禪師費心費思著了許多言語，攖寧禪師又不合上他釣鉤相罵，饒汝接嘴攖寧，攖寧總沒來由一肚皮好佛法說在空裏，他好心請益，只合好好對他說，為甚惡發起來，使諸方見了作是非得失商量，是何道理？這老宿所問一一是該問的，如今還有許多人疑著，雲溪不惜口業為你諸人解說一上，以息兩家之爭，省得後來
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J33/J33nB294.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Liangting Ting of Yunxi. Liangting Jingting owns the retained deployment: independent recorded-sayings deployment of the same line.

Senses.Explanation: The second half of Xiaoyin Daxin's shouted line, 'inside a thousand-year peach pit, what old kernel are you looking for?', exploiting 仁 as the kernel enclosed by a fruit stone while answering a demand for what lies within. Xiaoyin Daxin uses the expression through repeated direct preservation and raising of Xiaoyin's shouted peach-kernel line. Liangting Jingting independently deploys it through independent recorded-sayings deployment of the same line.

Senses.Explanation: Not even a hair can fit between: the phrase denies the smallest interval in the relation named by each case. Zhongfeng says awakened clarity and ordinary applications admit no intervening hair; Dahui places the phrase between one thought and its application; Xueyan compares the meeting to two mirrors with no hair admitted; Xieyun uses it for a house rule whose exacting edge leaves no gap.
